# Changing Azure API key settings via CLI (2026-02-02 08:02Z)

_**User (2026-02-02 08:05Z)**_

My Azure environment has been blocked from using API keys, however, a colleague on an internal form suggested we could chnage it thorugh CLI.

Study this post and my Azure environemnt and determine if this settings can be changed. If it can do it. fix it for me.

The post from a colleague,
PowerShell scriptlet is your firend: 
Install-Module -Name Az.CognitiveServices
Connect-AzAccount -Tenant (Get-AzContext).Tenant.Id -ClaimsChallenge "eyxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx" (this value will generated by Set-AzCognitiveServicesAccount)
Set-AzCognitiveServicesAccount -ResourceGroupName "xxxxx" -Name "yyyyyy" -DisableLocalAuth $false

```
Install-Module -Name Az.CognitiveServices

Set-AzCognitiveServicesAccount -ResourceGroupName "xxxxx" -Name "yyyyyy" -DisableLocalAuth $false
```

1. First run Set-AzCognitiveServicesAccount - it will fail but generate a claims challenge value
2. Then reconnect with that claims challenge value
3. Then run Set-AzCognitiveServicesAccount again

This is a pattern for dealing with Conditional Access Policies that require step-up authentication (like MFA for sensitive operations). The first attempt fails but gives you a claims challenge, then you use that to re-authenticate with elevated privileges, and then retry the operation.

**Prompt to enable API key authentication for Azure Cognitive Services:**

```
I need to enable API key authentication (local auth) for an Azure Cognitive Services resource. Our managed environment has policies that block this by default.

Please help me do the following in order:

1. First, install the Az.CognitiveServices module if needed
2. Connect to my Azure account (I'll authenticate when prompted)
3. List all my Cognitive Services accounts so I can identify the correct one
4. Add the tag "SecurityControl" = "Ignore" to the resource (use REST API if PowerShell doesn't work)
5. Then set DisableLocalAuth to $false on the same resource

My details:
- Resource Group: [YOUR_RESOURCE_GROUP]
- Account Name: [YOUR_ACCOUNT_NAME]
- Tenant ID: [YOUR_TENANT_ID] (optional, if you know it)

IMPORTANT: The SecurityControl=Ignore tag is a temporary bypass that only works for 14 days. After 14 days, the managed environment policy will re-enable DisableLocalAuth=true and you'll need to repeat this process.

Please run each step and confirm the final DisableLocalAuth value is False.
```
